description: List exactly the component values an effect, useCallback, useMemo or useImperativeHandle callback reads in its dependency array; a missing one leaves the callback reading stale values.

violation.message: Add `$MR` to this dependency array; the callback reads it, so without it the callback keeps a stale value.
Remove `$UE` from this dependency array: the callback does not read it, or it is an outer or `.current` value whose change never re-renders the component.
Remove the repeated `$DE` from this dependency array.
Pass the dependencies as an array literal written in place, so each value the callback reads can be checked against it.
List the dependencies one by one instead of spreading another list into this array, so each one can be checked.
Remove this literal from the dependency array; it never changes. If you meant the variable it names, list that variable instead.
Move this expression into a variable declared before the hook and list that variable, so the dependency can be checked.
Remove `$EV` from this dependency array; call a useEffectEvent function from the effect without listing it, since it is not a reactive value.
Keep `$WL` in a useRef and assign its `.current` instead, or declare it inside the callback; this assignment is lost after each render.
Copy `$CCR.current` to a variable inside the effect and use that variable in the cleanup; by the time the cleanup runs the ref may point elsewhere.
Pass a dependency array to this effect; it sets state on every run without one, which can re-render in an endless loop.
Wrap this value in its own useMemo or useCallback, or move it inside the hook that lists it; built anew each render, it reruns that hook every time.
Make this effect callback synchronous and call an async function from inside it; an async callback returns a promise where React expects a cleanup.
Pass a callback to this hook; without one React throws when it runs.
Pass a dependency array to this hook; with only a callback it recomputes on every render and memoizes nothing.
Pass an inline function to this hook, so the values it reads can be checked against its dependencies.
Add `$CBN` to this hook's dependency array, or pass an inline function; the value passed as its callback can change between renders.
